设备绑定和已保存的设置会保留。: Your devices and saved settings will be kept.
未识别到设备 ID，请手动输入: Device ID not recognized. Enter it manually.
设备开机联网后，输入屏幕显示或语音播报的 6 位验证码。: Connect the device and enter the six-digit code it displays or reads out.
输入设备 ID，或扫描设备二维码。: Enter the device ID or scan its QR code.
同账号设备自动关联。添加其他设备需对方同意。: Devices on this account are linked automatically. Other devices must accept your request.
同账号设备自动关联，无需申请。: Devices on this account are linked automatically.
留空使用设备名称，设备未命名时显示设备 ID。: Leave blank to use the device name, or its ID if unnamed.
备注仅对当前设备生效，最多 64 个字符。: This note applies to this device. Maximum 64 characters.
设备已离线，请检查电源和网络: Device offline. Check its power and connection.
请输入 1–13 个字符的设备名称: Enter a device name of 1–13 characters.
微信来电名称仍使用上次授权时的名称。请在微信中清理本小程序的授权记录后重新授权，: WeChat still uses the name from the previous authorization. Clear the authorization in WeChat and authorize again to update it.
设备列表暂时无法加载，请下拉刷新重试: Could not load devices. Refresh to try again.
添加第一台设备，开始使用小钛: Add your first device to get started
管理微信与设备的音视频通话授权: Manage WeChat audio and video calling
创建或加入房间，与多台设备语音对讲: Create or join a room to talk with other devices
查看设备与 AI 的历史文字对话: View the device’s previous AI conversations
查看设备 ID 及播放、通话能力: View device ID and playback and call capabilities
移除设备，同时清除微信通话和异常提醒授权: Remove device and clear WeChat calling and alert permissions
最多 13 个字符，用于设备列表与微信通话授权。: Up to 13 characters. Used for the device list and WeChat calling.
会话已删除，列表更新失败，请点击刷新。: Conversation deleted. Refresh to update the list.
页面不存在，请返回重试: Page unavailable. Go back and try again.
播放器加载失败，请检查网络后重试: Player unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
开启任一类型即可识别，全部关闭即停止。修改后自动保存。: Enable a type to start recognition. Turning all types off stops recognition. Changes save automatically.
设备配置已更新，载入最新设置后可继续修改。: Device settings have changed. Load the latest settings to continue.
每执行一个识别类型计一次，按 UTC 自然月统计。: Each recognition type counts as one run. Usage resets each UTC calendar month.
当前角色设定将替换为所选类型的默认设定。: The selected type’s default instructions will replace the current instructions.
当前环境无法试听，请在手机微信中重试: Audio preview is unavailable in this environment.
地域不可更改，跨地域请新建角色。: Region cannot be changed. Create a role to use a different region.
选择角色类型带入默认设定，或填写自定义角色设定: Choose a role type or enter custom instructions
暂无匹配的可用角色类型，可直接编辑角色设定。: No matching types. You can edit the role instructions directly.
放弃当前修改并返回角色列表？: Discard changes and return to the role list?
保存影响共用设备；切换角色请返回列表。: Saving affects all devices using this role. Switch roles from the list.
点角色名称查看设置。切换角色仅对当前设备生效。: Select a name to view settings. Switching roles affects only this device.
功能标识须为 1 至 64 位字母、数字或下划线: Use 1–64 letters, digits or underscores for the identifier.
请为每个参数填写字母、数字或下划线组成的名称: Use letters, digits or underscores for each parameter name.
操作已成功，状态更新失败，请点击刷新。: Operation succeeded. Refresh to update the status.
让这台设备创建或加入对讲房间，与同一房间内的其他设备进行语音对讲。: Create or join an intercom room to talk with other devices.
加入后设备默认收听，按住设备上的说话键发言。离线设备上线后自动加入。点击刷新查看: Devices listen after joining. Hold the device’s talk key to speak. Offline devices join when they reconnect. Refresh to see current status.
请再次点击右侧按钮确认微信授权: Tap again to confirm WeChat authorization.
当前微信将用于接收本账号的提醒。它与其他账号的接收关联、本账号原有的接收关联都将: This WeChat account will receive alerts. Previous links will be removed and other devices must be authorized again. Pending alerts for previous links will stop.
服务端尚未启用此提醒: Alerts are disabled on the server
识别到异常时，通过微信提醒我。: Notify me on WeChat when recognition detects an anomaly.
更换接收微信可重新授权，取消接收可在微信设置中管理。: Authorize again to change recipients. Manage notification permissions in WeChat settings.
以下为设备最近上报的音视频能力。设备离线时无法发起实时查看或通话。: Latest reported media capabilities. An offline device cannot stream or make calls.
请输入 0 至 86400 的整数秒: Enter a whole number from 0 to 86400.
请在微信小程序中授权接收此设备的异常提醒。: Authorize alerts for this device in the WeChat mini program.
开启 AI 识别后生效。: Takes effect when AI recognition is enabled.
拖动右侧图标或点击调整顺序: Drag the handle or tap to change the order.
已达上限 8 项，关闭其他类型后可继续开启: Eight types enabled. Turn one off to enable another.
我已阅读并同意: I have read and agree to
